==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
* 1 can (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:pumpkin|pumpkin]] [[Cookbook:Puree|purée]]
* 3 cups white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3½ cups [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Allspice|ground allspice]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|ground cinnamon]]
* 1½ teaspoons [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] raw pumpkin seeds, for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|375°F]].
# Butter and lightly flour 2 medium [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pans]] (8 ½ by 4 ½ by 2 ½ inches).
# Using a [[Cookbook:Mixer|stand mixer]] fitted with the paddle attachment, combine eggs, oil, pumpkin and sugar until smooth.
# In a separate bowl, combine the flour, soda, salt, allspice, cinnamon and nutmeg.
# With the machine on low speed, add the flour mixture to the pumpkin mixture in ¼-cup increments.
# Scrape down the side of the bowl and mix for another 30 seconds or so, until all ingredients are well-combined.
# Divide the mixture equally between the 2 loaf pans.
# Sprinkle the top of each loaf with 1 tablespoon pumpkin seeds.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 40–45 minutes until a tester inserted into the center of each loaf comes out clean.
# Allow loaves to cool in the pans for 5–10 minutes before unmolding, then allow loaves to cool on a wire rack to room temperature before cutting or wrapping.
